originalTitle: Fast remote nucleotide sequence alignment with Riboseek

summaries.zh: Riboseek 用重叠二联体、快速预筛选和迭代 profile search 加速 RNA 与 DNA 的远缘同源搜索，并为 RNA 结构预测生成更深的多序列比对。
summaries.en: Riboseek accelerates remote homology search for RNA and DNA with overlapping di-mers, fast prefiltering, and iterative profile search, generating deeper MSAs for RNA structure prediction.
